payload.search_intent: Inspiration and proof: see real couples' Italy weddings by region before choosing where and when. Mostly image-led SERP (Pinterest, Instagram, vendor galleries).
payload.angle: A curated hub of our own published Italy real weddings, grouped by region, each card telling the reader the venue, season and one telling detail, plus what that choice implies (season, ceremony type, guest travel) and where our region guide picks up. The invisible work shows through the cards: a June rainstorm at Villa Balbiano, a February Ravello date, a three-day Puglia weekend, a December Taormina wedding.
serp_gaps_to_win: Competitor hubs (Junebug, WeddingWire, weddingitaly.com, Easy Weddings) are galleries with no region grouping or planning takeaways
No hub groups Italy real weddings by region with season and venue facts per card
Few show Australian couples specifically; we have at least five
Nobody links each story to legal, best-time and cost guidance for that region
